summary: Intel jumped ~12-14% on 2026-09-21 (~25% Sept 15-21) as Meta's Muse AI agent fueled agentic-AI CPU-demand hopes; CEO Lip-Bu Tan said Intel fills only ~50% of CPU orders and raised capex forecast to $20B from $18B. Up 40%+ in September.
support_reason: CPU supply shortage and 25% revenue growth are fundamental, but valuation stretched; price above mean analyst target (~$120).
